summaries.summary: This class models the HPX Printer Details screen in an Android mobile app. It inherits from SmartFlow and provides comprehensive automation methods for interacting with various printer-related features including scanning, printing, copying, faxing, and printer information management. The class implements a consistent pattern of swipe-to-find-and-click for tile elements, with configurable timeout, exception handling, and maximum swipe attempts. Notable patterns include: (1) Extensive use of driver.wait_for_object() for element synchronization, (2) Fallback mechanisms like coordinate-based clicking in click_add_device_btn, (3) Conditional element handling in methods like click_feature_unavailable_popup_if_exist, and (4) Data retrieval methods for product information. The class supports multiple printer workflows including document/photo printing, scanning, copying, mobile fax, shortcuts, printables, and print quality tools.
